summary: Arch Capital Group Ltd. filed an 8-K disclosing early results and pricing of cash tender offers by its subsidiaries for up to $417,851,000 aggregate principal of two series of senior notes (5.144% Senior Notes due 2043 and 5.031% Senior Notes due 2046). The increased maximum amount targets debt reduction. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or specific price per share is stated. The mechanics involve issuer debt repurchase, reducing outstanding liabilities. What to watch: the final acceptance amount and any effect on credit profile; the risk-arb angle is minimal as this is a straightforward debt tender.
